sources.title: Mutianyu Great Wall Of China: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Mutianyu Great Wall: Complete Information Guide

Quick Overview
Mutianyu Great Wall is located 73 kilometers northeast of Beijing in Huairou District. This section features 5.4 kilometers of restored wall with 23 watchtowers, originally built during the Northern Qi Dynasty (6th century) and rebuilt during the Ming Dynasty in 1569.

Historical Significance
The site's name translates to "admiring the sky valley." During the Northern Qi period, it served as a crucial defense point. The Ming Dynasty reconstruction, overseen by General Qi Jiguang, introduced sophisticated architectural innovations including unique double-sided crenellations and granite construction standing 7-8 meters tall.

Why Visit
Mutianyu offers several advantages over other Great Wall sections:
Fewer crowds compared to Badaling
Authentic Ming architecture well-preserved through careful restoration
Superior photography opportunities, especially during autumn foliage
Accessible to all ages via modern infrastructure
Stunning mountain scenery with serpentine wall curves

Key Attractions
Watchtowers: Tower 14 (accessible via cable car) provides panoramic views. Towers 6 and 20 mark practical tourist limits.
Famous Dragon Curve: The section between Towers 11-15 showcases the wall's most photographed serpentine design following mountain ridgelines.
Cable Car System: A 10-minute ride provides effortless access. The return toboggan slide descent offers recreation through forested slopes.

Best Visiting Periods
Autumn (September-November): Deciduous forests display vibrant reds, oranges, and golds—considered peak season.
Spring (April-May): Cherry blossoms and fresh green foliage create picturesque conditions.
Winter: Snow-covered landscapes create monochromatic beauty, though fewer visitors arrive.
Summer: Lush vegetation but higher temperatures and occasional rain.

Practical Information
Hours & Access: Year-round operations with cable car service available in most weather conditions. Modern restroom facilities at visitor center, cable car stations, and multiple wall locations.
Food & Amenities: Restaurant and snack facilities provide Chinese and basic international food options.
Language Support: Basic English is spoken at ticket counters and visitor information areas.

Visitor Experience
Duration: Most visitors spend 3-4 hours total, including transportation from parking. Active hikers exploring multiple tower sections may need 5-6 hours.
Accessibility: Cable car system makes the main wall accessible to most age groups. However, walking involves steep steps and uneven surfaces.
Toboggan slide suits ages 6 and up.

Badaling Comparison: Mutianyu provides more authentic experience with fewer crowds, better scenery, and unique architectural features like double-sided crenellations, versus Badaling's accessibility but significant commercialization.

sources.title: Ultimate Mutianyu Great Wall Visiting Guide 2026
sources.content:
Ultimate Mutianyu Great Wall Visiting Guide 2026

Mutianyu Great Wall stands 73 kilometers northeast of Beijing. On average, it takes about 1.5 to 2 hours depending on traffic.

Best seasons are Spring/Autumn; particularly April, May, September and October. Late October for stunning autumn foliage or early spring for cherry blossoms. Arrive by 7:30 AM to beat the crowds.

It offers convenient cable cars and an exciting toboggan ride, making it suitable for travelers of all ages, including children and seniors. The Toboggan slide down from Watchtower 6 is the highlight for most visitors.

Visitors are advised to take the cable car to Watchtower 14 and first explore the western route, then on return, leisurely descend along the eastern route with an opportunity to try the toboggan ride.

Pack plenty of snacks and water, as options on the wall can be limited and pricier. Comfortable shoes are a must. Online booking is recommended during peak seasons.

sources.title: Mutianyu Great Wall: Toboggan Slide, Cable Car, or Chairlift?
sources.content:
Mutianyu Great Wall: Toboggan Slide, Cable Car, or Chairlift?

Cable car tickets cost CNY 100 for one way or CNY 140 for both ways, with free admission for children under 1.2m. Toboggan/chairlift tickets are also CNY 100 one way or CNY 140 for both ways.

The cable car is 723 meters long and takes about 5-6 minutes to reach the top. Known as the No.1 Cable Way of the Great Wall of China, it's equipped with 58 enclosed cable cars.

The chairlift is 550 meters long. The toboggan is only available for descending, with a ride taking around 5 minutes. Children under 10 must be accompanied by an adult.

Although there are fewer visitors to Mutianyu than Badaling, you may still need to wait around an hour for the cable car during peak periods.

sources.title: Mutianyu Great Wall: Facts, Travel Tips & Maps
sources.content:
Mutianyu Great Wall: Facts, Travel Tips & Maps

Location: 73 km northeast of Beijing, Huairou District
Wall length: 5,400 meters with 23 watchtowers
Admission: 40 CNY
Cable car: 100 CNY one-way / 140 CNY round-trip
Toboggan: 100 CNY one-way / 140 CNY round-trip (with chairlift up)

For public buses, only take the 916快车 (express), not the regular 916.

The steepest section is near Watchtowers 19 to 20. This part has a very steep incline with uneven stone steps.

Facilities: restaurants and shops near the entrance, bathrooms at the base and top station near the cable car.

Best times: April, May, September, October. Arrive early to avoid crowds.

sources.title: 慕田峪长城 - 百度百科
sources.content:
慕田峪长城

基本信息
慕田峪长城位于北京市怀柔区渤海镇慕田峪村，距北京城区73千米。全长5400米，是中国最长的长城，也是北京十六景之一。享有"万里长城，慕田峪独秀"的美誉。

历史沿革
南北朝北齐时期（550-577年）就在慕田峪筑有长城。明洪武元年（1368年），由朱元璋手下大将徐达在北齐长城遗址上督建而成。明永乐二年（1404年）建立慕田峪关。明隆庆三年（1569年），抗倭名将戚继光奉命对包括慕田峪在内的二千里长城进行整修，隆庆五年（1571年）秋完成。
1983年进行修复开发，1988年4月正式对外开放。

遗址特色
布局特点：长城由城墙、敌楼、城关、烽火台等建筑物共同构筑完整的军事防御体系。慕田峪有三道长城汇合在海拔603米的山顶，形成著名的北京结。

主要特色：
1. 关台奇特 - 正关台又称三座楼，由三座空心敌楼构成，上下两层。关门不设正中，而在关台东侧，这种设计在万里长城罕见。
2. 敌楼密集 - 从慕字一台至慕字四台，不到500米就设敌楼4座；从一台至二十台，仅3000米敌楼就有25座。
3. 双面垛口 - 慕田峪长城两面都为垛口墙，意味着两侧同敌作战，体现其重要战略地位。
4. 内外支城并存 - 包含外支城和内支城（秃尾巴边）。

主要建筑
正关台：位于海拔486米的隘口处，长40米、宽30米、高20米，为上下两层。包含9间楼房，具有囤粮、屯兵功能。
大角楼：位于慕田峪关东侧制高点，编名慕字一台。是蓟镇长城和昌镇长城的分界线。
箭扣长城：长城之险在慕田峪，慕田峪之险在箭扣。形状犹如仰放的弓。

文物保护
1987年被联合国教科文组织列入世界文化遗产名录。2006年5月25日被国务院公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。2011年被评定为AAAAA级旅游风景区。

旅游信息
门票价格：40元/人，优惠票20元/人
交通：公交H23路、H35路、H36路慕田峪环岛站；自驾京承高速13号出口

sources.title: Great Wall of China Mutianyu Tour Review: Everything I Wish I Knew
sources.content:
Great Wall of China Mutianyu Tour Review

Mutianyu is less crowded than other sections, but it still gets busy by late morning — especially on weekends and public holidays. While Badaling is the most popular section and can get very crowded, Mutianyu offers a more peaceful walk and is just as impressive, if not more.

Wear comfortable walking shoes — there are lots of steps! Bring sunblock, a hat, and water, especially in the warmer months. Layers are your best friend, as the weather can shift quickly in the mountains.

You can choose to hike the west or east route of the Mutianyu Wall, or both sides, which takes around 3 hours in total.

The toboggan ride down is one of the highlights of visiting Mutianyu. It's a fun and unique way to end your Great Wall adventure.

The steepest section is near Watchtowers 19 to 20, with uneven stone steps that get progressively more challenging. Not for the faint of heart — but rewarded with the most dramatic panoramic views.

Facilities: restaurants and shops near the entrance. Bathrooms at the base and top station near the cable car.

sources.title: Mutianyu Great Wall Travel Tips & Tours
sources.content:
Mutianyu Great Wall Travel Tips & Tours

Mutianyu is about 73 km northeast of central Beijing, travel time 1.5 to 2 hours. Average time for this activity is half a day.

Mutianyu Great Wall operates under peak season hours from March 16 to November 15, 2026. Opening hours: Weekdays 7:30-18:00, Weekends 7:30-18:30.

Admission: 40 CNY. Cable car: 100 CNY one-way, 140 CNY round-trip. Toboggan: 100 CNY one-way.

A modern visitor center provides restrooms, gift shop, restaurant, and information desk with staff who speak basic English.

For public transport, take bus 916 express from Dongzhimen to Huairou, then transfer to local bus H23/H35/H36 to Mutianyu.
